facts.text: The `before_agent_start` hook in `extensions/memory-history/extension.ts` appends a `<memory_workflow>` block when `memory_history` is active. It tells the agent to run `memory_history` search with scope `all` before investigating or editing a project task, and to treat results as leads until their cited evidence is inspected.

The Harness-engineer control loop in `prompts/swarm-system-prompt.md` (heading `## Harness-engineer control loop`) step 2 requires recalling prior evidence with memory before investigating a project task or question, and whenever the user references earlier work.

`tools/bench/build-arms.py` builds prompt arms F, M, FM and FL into an output directory and writes `M.diff`. The M arm applies four adaptations: AUTO as the start mode, an Agent-MCP to trebol tool mapping, removal of the Arch sudo section, and removal of a stray user request.

`tools/bench/validate-fix.sh SHA` checks a fix commit as a benchmark task. It overlays the commit's changed `*.test.ts` files onto the parent and reports whether vitest fails there and passes at the fix commit.
